summary: The diff implements a comprehensive Omm Vedic Numerology website with frontend and backend components. Most requirements are well-covered: the homepage, services section, booking form, backend model, and visual theme are all present. The main gap is REQ-6 — while the code references the generated image assets (hero-banner.dim_1440x600.png, tarot-icon.dim_256x256.png, etc.) from frontend/public/assets/generated, no actual image files appear in the diff as added files. The diff summary notes one file was omitted due to limits, but there is no evidence the four service icons and hero banner were generated and placed in the assets directory.

missing_requirements.requirement: Generate and display a banner/hero background image and service icon illustrations for each of the four services, rendered as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated.
missing_requirements.reason: The code references image paths for hero-banner.dim_1440x600.png and four service icons but none of these actual image files appear in the 21 added files. At most one omitted file could account for a single asset, leaving at least four image files unaccounted for.

hallucinated_features.description: Social media links (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube) in the footer
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention social media links or footer social icons. The HomePage imports SiInstagram, SiFacebook, SiYoutube from react-icons/si, indicating social media links were added without being requested.

hallucinated_features.description: About section with brand story and feature cards
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not include an About section as a requirement. The AboutSection component was created and added to the page with its own nav link, which was not requested.
The build request explicitly lists user authentication or login system as a non-goal, yet the implementation includes InternetIdentityProvider, useInternetIdentity hook, and AuthClient integration.
